status: DRAFT for review: the compliance requirements NAM proposes (FRS F26), from the public procurement orders as generally applied in Indian PSU tenders; the user department confirms each one per case, and NRL confirms this list before production use

requirements.text: Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises: an MSE quoting within L1 + 15% may supply part of the quantity by matching L1, as the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs allows.
requirements.basis: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012

requirements.text: MSEs registered for the item or service are exempt from paying the EMD (bid security).
requirements.basis: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012

requirements.text: Purchase preference to Class-I local suppliers under the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order; the local content each class needs is as that order sets.
requirements.basis: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017

requirements.text: A bidder who is not the OEM submits the OEM's authorisation for the offered items.
Prior experience and turnover criteria are relaxed for recognised startups that meet the quality and technical specification.
requirements.basis: Department of Expenditure guidance on startups

requirements.text: The bidder submits a clause-by-clause compliance statement against the technical specification.
The contractor complies with the Contract Labour Act, the minimum wages, PF and ESI for every worker deployed.
